newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Pacific unit to close $200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pacific unit to close $200 mln loan.

text.p: Syndication for Florens Container Corp's US$200 million term loan facility is expected to be completed next week, bankers said on Wednesday.
They said the facility is well-received and is likely to be oversubscribed.
The borrower is a wholly-owned subsidiary of COSCO Pacific, which is guarantor of the deal. The amortising loan is secured by a letter of comfort from COSCO Beijing.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. Repayment is in three annual equal instalments after three years' grace.
It pays an interest margin of 70 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Management fees are 31 basis points for lead managers, 28 basis points for co-lead managers, 26 basis points for senior managers and 24 basis points for managers.
The arrangers group include Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, BZW Asia, Credit Lyonnais, DBS Bank, Hongkong Bank, Paribas Asia and Schroders Asia.
Proceeds are to be used for expanding the company's container fleet capacity.
